Mediterranus, God of the Mediterranean-Black Sea system - A jovial and lively god, ruling over the interconnected waters of the Mediterranean Sea and the Black Sea. He is associated with trade, navigation, and cultural exchange, and is known for his love of feasting and merriment. He is often depicted with a trident and a cornucopia, symbolizing his abundance and generosity.

== Conflicting story ==


[[Mediterranus|Mediterranea]], Goddess of the Mediterranean Sea - A graceful and alluring goddess, presiding over the azure waters of the Mediterranean Sea. She is associated with beauty, love, and romance, and is known for her serene and enchanting presence. She is often depicted with a seashell and a pearl, symbolizing her connection with the sea and its treasures.
